contents.text: Vegetables and fruits can be aquired by either growing the corresponding crop, or by mining certaing natural blocks, like leaves, grass, and bushes
The item dropped by a crop or vegetation block can depend on a variety of options. Most drops depend primarily on the biome where it's planted
When transplanting a crop from one biome to another, there is a high chance that the new produce will be a slight varient of the original.
For example, if you harvest potatoes in a plains biome, and then plant some of those in a jungle biome, you will harvest sweet potatos.
The crops are organized based on the plant from which they drop.
